title: Grateful Dead Live at Grand Prix Racecourse on 1973-07-27

ai_review.summary: Matrix recording with crystal‑clear sound captures a stellar 1973 show highlighted by a soaring second‑set jam, early Fire on the Mountain ideas and a powerful Wharf Rat prelude.
ai_review.review: The performance is repeatedly praised for its ecstatic ensemble interplay – a phenomenal second‑set jam that morphs into an embryonic Fire on the Mountain and a thrilling lead‑in to Wharf Rat. Reviewers also note excellent stage banter and flawless sound, with Keith Godchaux’s dramatic entrance on electric piano adding extra fire. The matrix source delivers a clean, balanced mix that lets every instrument shine.

ai_rating.rationale: All six reviews are overwhelmingly positive (5‑star except one 4‑star), praising both the musical performance and the sound quality; the matrix recording is described as good to excellent, leading to a high combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, balanced mix with no reported drop‑outs or muddiness; reviewers specifically call out the sound as "good" and "best for the jam."

standout_songs: Fire on the Mountain (early shape in the jam)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth, with a particularly electrifying second set; the jam builds organically into Fire on the Mountain themes before launching into Wharf Rat, and stage banter keeps the energy high throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for his pick‑and‑finger guitar work and overall ensemble contribution during the jams.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for exploring the lower register on bass, adding depth to the improvisations.
band_member_comments.Bob: His rhythmic counterpoint is highlighted as a key element of the jam’s texture.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith Godchaux sits out the first ~10 minutes of the jam then bursts in with fiery electric‑piano fills, greatly enhancing the flow.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann's cymbal work receives specific commendation for driving the jam forward.
